schedule: Complete one-step endpoint scoring and best admissible descent until one-step closure, then complete two-step scoring. After any two-step improvement repeat one-step descent and two-step scoring. Finish only when the same final center has no admissible improvement at either depth.
scoringSelection: All final hard-legal and comfort-passing states; no additive, motor, random or top-K preselection
winnerAdmission: CKT ascending prefix of improving states; original 20-track independent audit until first admissible state, or all improving states if every one is rejected
cacheReuse: Canonical 62-byte physical state with full source, template, binary, corpus and archived-evidence hashes validated; reject contradictory full-track scores
scope: Final-center one/two-operation local closure under the fixed contracts; no unrestricted two-token, other-basin or global optimality claim
